description: Updates come on the 1st and the 15th, grouped, and are merged once main's required checks pass, unless they raise a major version. release-please collects the fix(deps) ones in the release pull request, which is merged by hand.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes come at once, outside the schedule.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refreshes uv.lock, which pins the dev tools and the versions CI tests against; no release contains it.

customManagers.description: uv's version in pyproject.toml, which CI requires to equal the dev container's and the prek hook's.

packageRules.description: A library keeps its runtime dependency ranges wide; it only raises a lower bound when a new version falls outside the range. Home Assistant pins modbus-connection per release, so CI tests the lower bound. Such a change reaches users, so it is a fix release-please releases.
The dev and release groups, which no release contains.
uv in the dev container, pyproject.toml and the prek hook together: CI fails while they differ.
The dev container, which no release contains.
A new Python minor version is raised by hand, in the dev container, CI and the classifiers together; only the image's digest comes from here.
A major version waits for review.
